title: cormus domestica
intro: Cormus domestica, commonly known as the American dogwood, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to eastern North America. The health benefits of C. domestica include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and act as an antioxidant, which can help protect against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of C. domestica include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating pain, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of C. domestica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
